author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-uv
title: Python monorepo with uv
description: A uv workspace: a FastAPI API and shared Python packages with a single lockfile, tests with pytest and linting with Ruff.

base.command: command -v uv >/dev/null || { echo 'Necesitas uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir {{name}}

writeFiles.content:
# Virtual workspace root: it only groups the members and the dev tools.
[tool.uv.workspace]
members = ["apps/*", "packages/*"]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest", "httpx", "ruff"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["apps", "packages"]

[project]
name = "api"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = ["fastapi", "uvicorn", "core"]

[tool.uv.sources]
core = { workspace = true }

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

from api.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)


def test_greet() -> None:
    response = client.get("/greet/Ana")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"message": "Hello, Ana!"}

[project]
name = "core"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = []

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

verify.command: uv run pytest -q --import-mode=importlib && uv run ruff check .

instructions:
## How to work here

- Each app (`apps/`) and package (`packages/`) is a workspace member with its own `pyproject.toml`; there's a single `uv.lock` at the root.
- A member uses another by declaring it in `dependencies` and in `[tool.uv.sources]` with `{ workspace = true }`.
- Add dependencies from the member's folder: `uv add <package>` (or `uv add --package api <package>` from the root).
- Before finishing: `uv run pytest -q --import-mode=importlib && uv run ruff check .`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
